name: fyrst/shopware-cd
description: fyrst.dev Shopware continuous-deploy overlay: Composer-native apply of dual CI, Compose, and VPS deploy files after shopware-cli project create. Not a Shopware installation.

suggest.shopware/docker: Official multi-stage Dockerfile via Symfony Flex (usually docker/Dockerfile). Require it in the shop; this overlay's Dockerfile is a fallback only.
suggest.shopware/deployment-helper: Deploy-time install/update. Require it in the shop (bin/create does this). Not required here so this package never pulls Shopware core.
